turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm trying to improve the retrieval accuracy for my knowledge base. I noticed the current search is missing relevant notes when I search for specific concepts mentioned in the text.
That sounds frustrating. Are you currently searching only through the note titles or metadata?
Exactly. It's too shallow. I've decided that the overlap() function should score note bodies (or their H2s) rather than just titles for the note channel.
Understood. Shifting the focus to the body content will definitely increase recall for specific concepts.
Right. It's just a quick lunch break thing, but I want to make sure the next iteration handles it correctly. Also, did you check if the delivery for the new monitor is still on schedule?
I haven't checked the monitor delivery status yet, but I can look into that for you. Regarding the code change, I'll keep your preference in mind for the next review.
Thanks. The monitor is just a distraction, focus on the code logic. I need to go, back later.
Got it. Have a good afternoon.
